# Scope: a judge in the Bet Din. The cited work ($SOURCE$, a flag) counts a citation, once per community; canon counts nothing.
kehillah_din_record_citation_dispatch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		kehillah_sefer_record_citation_effect = { KEY = work_targum_onkelos }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_mekhilta }
		kehillah_sefer_record_citation_effect = { KEY = work_mekhilta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_genesis_rabbah }
		kehillah_sefer_record_citation_effect = { KEY = work_genesis_rabbah }
	}

# Scope: the author of a Talmudics gloss. The book covers the order of the
# work it glosses ($SLOT$ his authored slot).
kehillah_sefer_gloss_seder_dispatch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_comment_on ?= flag:work_mekhilta }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_seder value = flag:nezikin }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_comment_on ?= flag:work_mishnah }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_seder value = flag:nezikin }
	}
	else_if = {
